title: posture.frames.v1 — 0.5 s of raw 9-joint coordinate frames from the app (BE API spec 2026-10-13)
description: FE proposal 2.1. One message per interval [start_ms, end_ms), times relative to the session start. Frames are not averaged. rest/away intervals carry no frames. valid:false marks a frame whose user position the app could not determine (10/12 meeting; BE confirmed the name on 10/13); since 2026-10-27 (FE ADR 0021) such a frame carries no coordinates: {t_ms, p: null, valid: false}. Carried as items of the WebSocket v2 features message. The camera size is fixed at 640x480 (DB V2.3 CAPTURE_RESOLUTION), so it is not sent; the app refuses to start with any other size.

joint.description: [x, y, visibility]; x and y are 0-1 ratios of the frame (5 decimals), y grows downward, not mirrored.

p.description: MediaPipe joints 0, 2, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 in that order; null when nobody was tracked.
